posts.headline: Send your VAT return to HMRC for 99p a month
posts.short: DIY Accounting Submit™ sends your VAT return to HMRC under Making Tax Digital. 99p a month, cancel any time. Start with {offer}: {link}
posts.long:
Making Tax Digital means your VAT return goes to HMRC from software. DIY Accounting Submit™ is that software, and it costs 99p a month.

You fill in the nine boxes, or drop your DIY Accounting spreadsheet or a DIYA-GL™ book on the page to fill them in. Boxes 3 and 5 add up for you. We send the return to HMRC, and HMRC's receipt comes back with its Form Bundle Number. We keep it with your account.

You can also see which VAT periods are due, and look up any return you have already sent.

DIY Accounting Submit is listed on HMRC's software finder for Making Tax Digital VAT. We are DIY Accounting Limited, a family company. Our founder, Terry Cartwright, started designing our accounting spreadsheets in 2006.

Cancel any time. Start with {offer}: {link}

posts.headline: Keep your spreadsheet. Send the VAT return from it.
posts.short: Making Tax Digital doesn't mean giving up your spreadsheet. Put its figures into DIY Accounting Submit™ and we send the VAT return to HMRC. Start with {offer}: {link}
posts.long:
If you keep your books in a spreadsheet, you can carry on under Making Tax Digital for VAT. You need bridging software to send the return, and DIY Accounting Submit™ is bridging software.

If you use our spreadsheets, drop the workbook on the VAT return page and the boxes fill in. A DIYA-GL™ book works the same way. If your spreadsheet is your own, type the final figures into the nine boxes. Boxes 3 and 5 add up for you.

Check the figures, then send. HMRC's receipt comes back with its Form Bundle Number, and we keep it with your account. You can look up any return you have sent, straight from HMRC.

99p a month, cancel any time. Start with {offer}: {link}

posts.headline: Try DIY Accounting Submit™ free
posts.short: Try DIY Accounting Submit™ with {offer}. Sign in with Google, connect to HMRC and send your VAT return. {link}
posts.long:
You can send a real VAT return to HMRC with DIY Accounting Submit™ without paying. Start with {offer}.

Sign in with your Google account, then connect to HMRC with your Government Gateway details. We show the VAT periods HMRC has open for you. Pick the one that is due, fill in the nine boxes, or drop your DIY Accounting spreadsheet on the page, and send.

HMRC's receipt comes back with its Form Bundle Number, and we keep it with your account.

If you want to keep going, it is 99p a month, and you can cancel any time. {link}

posts.short: Every VAT-registered business sends its VAT return through Making Tax Digital software, whatever its turnover. DIY Accounting Submit™ is 99p a month. {link}
posts.long:
Making Tax Digital for VAT covers every VAT-registered business, whatever its turnover. Your first VAT period that started on or after 1 April 2022 was the first one under the rule.

It means your VAT return goes to HMRC from software. DIY Accounting Submit™ is HMRC recognised software for it, and it is listed on HMRC's software finder for Making Tax Digital VAT.

You fill in the nine boxes, or drop your DIY Accounting spreadsheet on the page. We send the return, and HMRC's receipt comes back with its Form Bundle Number. You can see which VAT periods are due, and look up any return you have sent.

posts.headline: HMRC's receipt for every VAT return, kept with your account
posts.short: Send a VAT return with DIY Accounting Submit™ and HMRC's receipt comes back with its Form Bundle Number. We keep it with your account. {link}
posts.long:
A VAT return is done when HMRC says so. With DIY Accounting Submit™ you see HMRC's answer on the page: the receipt with its Form Bundle Number, your proof that you sent it. We keep it with your account.

You can also see which VAT periods are open and which are done, in words as well as colour, and look up any return you have sent before, straight from HMRC.

The site is built to WCAG 2.2 Level AA, and it works with screen readers and the keyboard.

99p a month, cancel any time. Start with {offer}: {link}
